## Problem

Describe the behavior or maintenance problem.

## Change

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Changed behavior has a focused test, or the reason it cannot is explained
- [ ] Safety-sensitive copy and routing were reviewed when affected
- [ ] Documentation matches configuration and data-flow changes
- [ ] No credentials, private user data, generated logs, or test artifacts are included

List any live tests separately. Live TypeSafe tests spend credits and send test
content to the provider.
